cutout — 3D augment op

• Data kinds: points → points

• Call: import pcl_augment; pcl_augment.cutout(points, extent: 'Union[float, np.ndarray]', seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]' (or ops3d.get("cutout"))

Usage

Remove an axis-aligned box region in space and return `(kept, kept_idx)` (mimicking a local dropout).
